Evidence Note 18

Infrastructure built as a central service disappears when its funding does. Conditional requests combined with content hashing remove most redundant fetching. Citation drift is more dangerous than link rot because nothing visibly breaks. Saying that we do not know is better than giving a fast wrong answer.

Preserved versions let anyone recover the text as it was when cited. A large share of cited web content changes within a few years of publication.
